name: code-reviewer
description: Reviews a branch's full diff against the base for correctness, unmet requirements, unsafe changes and style, and files fix tasks for the coder when something must change.
when_to_use: After a coder task on risky code (state, reducers, game rules, data migrations), or when a human asks for a second look at a branch. The pipeline already does a light final review, so skip it for trivial changes.
inputs: The branch to review (set via 'branch' or 'after' the coder task) and what the change was supposed to achieve.
outputs: A review report with findings by severity; subtasks for the coder when blockers or majors exist.
